proposals.research_question: Can a user capture several short ideas on an existing board?
proposals.participant_prompt: Add the ideas listed in your task to the board so your teammates can read them.
proposals.rationale: Release notes from upstream commit subjects report a newly shipped sticky-note capability; support complaints are sample data and no human evidence exists yet.
uncertainties: No baseline human test has been completed.

scenario.intro: Help add the ideas to the board so the team can review them.

steps.instruction: Review the ideas listed in the task.
Add each idea to the board.
Check that your ideas are visible.

think_aloud_cues: What do you expect to happen next?

proposals.research_question: Can a user make several shapes share an existing shape's fill?
proposals.participant_prompt: Make the selected shapes use the same fill as the reference shape.
proposals.rationale: Release notes from upstream commit subjects report bucket fill and color tools; support complaints are sample data and no human evidence exists yet.
uncertainties: No baseline human test has been completed.

scenario.intro: Help make the selected shapes use the same fill.

steps.instruction: Choose one shape as the visual reference.
Update the other shapes to match it.

proposals.research_question: Can a user bring an off-screen region of the board into view?
proposals.participant_prompt: Bring the region marked for the team offsite into view.
proposals.rationale: Release notes from upstream commit subjects report navigation improvements; support complaints are sample data and no human evidence exists yet.
uncertainties: No baseline human test has been completed.

scenario.intro: Help bring the marked region of the board into view.

steps.instruction: Review the board currently on screen.
Find the region marked for the team offsite.
Bring that region fully into view.
